title: Manufacturing — material property lookup
task: Go to https://webbook.nist.gov/chemistry/ and look up the substance ethanol by its CAS registry number, 64-17-5. Open the matching substance record and read the general information NIST lists for it. Then report exactly four values, using NIST's own labels: the substance Name, the Formula, the Molecular weight, and the CAS Registry Number printed on the record. Also state whether that CAS registry number matches the 64-17-5 you searched for. Stop once you have reported those four values and the match verdict.

portal.label: CAS Registry Number
portal.hint: Exact registry-number matches are listed first, then related species.
portal.answer: Name Ethanol, Formula C2H6O, Molecular weight 46.0684, CAS Registry Number 64-17-5 - matches the search
